description: This file contains database migration scripts for collapsing alerting models into a single model within the Superset project. It defines ORM classes for alerts, SQL observers, and validators, and includes upgrade and downgrade functions to modify database schema and migrate data accordingly.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Represents an alert with fields for SQL query, validator type, validator configuration, and associated database ID.

classes.name: SQLObserver
classes.description: Represents an SQL observer linked to an alert, with foreign key relationship to Alert.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Represents a validator associated with an alert, including validator type and configuration.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema migration to collapse alerting models into a single alert table, including data migration and handling database-specific differences.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts the schema changes made in upgrade, restoring previous tables and data structure for alerting models.
